scope: Repository-source response field and sensitivity contracts for every Supabase Edge Function declared in config.toml.

factBoundary.providerFacts: No hosted behavior is asserted; runtime state requires an authorized provider readback.
factBoundary.sourceChangePolicy: Every configured entrypoint and transitive repository-local import is fingerprinted. Drift fails closed until this contract is reviewed and regenerated.

classifications.public: Safe for unauthenticated public response projection.
classifications.operational: Bounded status, count, timestamp, or safe error information; no member content or credential.
classifications.internal: Provider, moderation, or workflow metadata restricted to an authorized operator or service caller.
classifications.confidential: Member identity, guild content, private media, gameplay, claim, or participation data.
classifications.credential: Short-lived bearer credential returned only by an authenticated private capability endpoint.
